title: 第十四章 传功授法【收藏推荐】
novel_title: 方彻最快更新(长夜君主)
content_zh: 印神宫说完这段话，吸了一口气，目光变得凝重。喝道：“注意，听好看好！”“血灵剑法，以心神为凭，以神意引领，剑未出，神已至，剑诀虚捏引破绽，剑诀捏实剑已出；剑尖到处神已移，敌血溅时我已归，无忧反噬之机……”他口中缓缓念诵功法，以身体灵气幻化运功线路，身法步法随着剑法展开，左手捏着剑诀，不断变换剑指。血灵七剑，一招一式，缓缓使出。印神宫的速度很慢，比起孙元平时传授，还要慢了许多。但是这血灵七剑，虽然说是‘七剑’但是其中身法步法剑诀变化，再加上行功线路，再加上精气神的配合……简直可说是千变万化。浩瀚之极。木林远等四人也在同时看着，但是到了第二招的时候，就感觉头晕脑胀。纷纷停下努力，心中叹息。如此浩瀚复杂，如何能一遍学会？这小子，恐怕是狗咬尿泡空欢喜一场了。印神宫一边用剑，心里也是有些无奈，今日突发奇想做出这事儿，着实有些异想天开的荒谬了。自己当年足足练了三个月，才算是初初入门。只给这小子看一遍的机会，累死他也记不住啊。为了天蜈神的欣赏自己就做出这事儿，实在是有点轻率了……长剑剑光一收。剑意回归丹田，印神宫沉默了一下，道：“你记住了多少？”声音中，已经没有半点期待。无人应答。转头一看，只见方彻正一动不动的站着，一脸凝重，眼神看着前方，却又空洞至极，似乎正在最深层的思考记忆之中。半刻钟后。方彻眨眨眼睛，恢复了清明之色，道：“还请教主指点。”说着飘身而出三尺，拔剑出鞘。“咦？！”印神宫与三位供奉都是眼睛猛地瞪大了，甚至控制不住的惊讶一声。因为方彻这个起手式，甚至是飘身而出的步法，以及那种飘逸的感觉，居然与刚才的印神宫一模一样！若不是衣服脸孔不一样，只看背影的话，几乎以为是印神宫自己又出去了。“这小子……有意思。”印神宫顿时提起了几分期待，目光灼灼看着。方彻站定，手中长剑振臂而出，寒光一闪，脚下随即从不丁不八变成了一脚前迈。脚后跟微微抬起，足弓悬空，脚尖点地，从鞋子前方弧度可以看出，只是用大脚趾和第二趾点地，脚尖处在半旋状。左手剑诀捏住，似乎捏住了前方敌人的弱点，一股灵气丹田升起，冲进右臂，正是血灵七剑第一式的起始线路。寒光一闪，剑刺出。身体微微前倾的弧度，也与印神宫刚才一模一样。甚至那种从容的神韵，也具备了几分。口中缓缓念诵：“血灵剑法，以心神为凭，以神意引领，剑未出，神已至，剑诀虚捏引破绽，剑诀捏实剑已出；剑尖到处神已移，敌血溅时我已归，无忧反噬之机……”刚才印神宫念出来的所有，他竟然一字一字的复述出来。身法完全一样。步法完全一致。剑诀完全相同。口诀一字不差。一招变化落下，随即开始第二招，第三招，第四招……旁边，印神宫的眼睛越瞪越大。一侧，木林远，侯方，钱三江等都是目瞪口呆，三张嘴，张的直接能生吞鹅蛋。孙元也没好到哪里去。整张脸都呆滞了。他这才知道，自己教授的时候，这小子甚至根本没怎么用心学。血灵七剑看一遍就会，那自己教的那些，算什么？还用得了一个时辰？印神宫震惊到了都不能思考的地步。以他的眼力，自然一眼看出来，方彻根本没有接触过血灵七剑，从没学习过。因为，一招一式的生涩，是很明显的，那是初学者必然有的生涩。只具备了形，而没有任何神韵，更加还不具备杀伤威力。只是依样画葫芦而已。所以‘这小子之前学过’这种疑惑，只是一闪就消失了。世间独有，除非自己教了他然后自己却忘了。但是，这也太快了些！只是一遍啊！全记住了？这一刻，这位一心教的教主甚至都听到了自己的心跳在激烈加速。天才啊！一直到了第七招，也就是血灵七剑的最后一剑，终于速度慢了下来，而且有几个动作不标准。但，终究还是圆满的记了下来。一遍剑招施展完毕，鸦雀无声。方彻收剑，站在原地不动，在自己思考这一遍的错漏之处。然后轻声道：“到了第五剑，转身出剑的时候，步法不对，姿势有些偏移，剑诀慢了半拍……到了第七剑，基本就是彻底乱了，足足有……六……八九……，对，九处错误，而且，口诀里有一句‘剑挑敌血，化空灵之肃杀’拿捏不准对错，是肃杀？还是肃煞？从意境来看，应该是煞气的煞吧？那就是气势的修炼？”
content_en: After Yinshen Palace said this, he took a breath and his eyes became solemn.He shouted: "Pay attention, listen carefully and watch carefully!" "The Blood Spirit Sword Technique is based on the mind and guided by the will of the spirit. Before the sword comes out, the spirit has arrived. The sword technique is used to draw out the flaw, and the sword technique is pinched firmly to draw out the sword. The spirit has moved everywhere on the sword tip. When the enemy's blood is splashed, I have returned, and there is no chance of backlash..." He chanted the technique slowly in his mouth, using the aura of his body to transform the movement route. The body and footwork unfolded with the sword technique, and he held the sword technique with his left hand, constantly changing the sword fingers.The Seven Blood Spirit Swords were used slowly, one move at a time.The speed of Yin Shen Palace is very slow, much slower than what Sun Yuan usually teaches.But the Seven Blood Spirit Swords, although they are called "Seven Swords", the changes in body movements, footwork, sword techniques, the lines of exercise, and the coordination of energy, energy and spirit... can be said to be ever-changing.Extremely vast.Mulinyuan and the other four people were also watching at the same time, but when it came to the second move, they felt dizzy.They all stopped their efforts and sighed in their hearts.How can it be learned in one go when it is so vast and complex?This kid, I'm afraid he's just having fun with his dog biting his urine.While Yin Shen Palace was using his sword, he felt a little helpless. He suddenly thought of doing this today, which was really a bit whimsical and ridiculous.I practiced for a full three months before I was just getting started.I only gave this kid a chance to read it once, and he was too exhausted to remember it.It was a bit rash to do this just for the appreciation of the God Centipede... The long sword drew back its light.The sword intention returned to Dantian, Yinshen Palace was silent for a moment, and said: "How much do you remember?" There was no trace of expectation in his voice.No one answered.Turning around, he saw Fang Chezheng standing motionless, his face solemn, his eyes looking forward, but extremely empty, as if he was deep in thought and memory.Half an hour later.Fang Che blinked his eyes, regained his clarity, and said, "Please give me some advice from the leader." After saying that, he floated three feet away and unsheathed his sword."Huh?!" The eyes of Yin Shen Palace and the three worshipers suddenly widened, and they even couldn't help but let out a cry of surprise.Because Fang Che's starting position, even the footwork of floating out, and the elegant feeling are exactly the same as the Yinshen Palace just now!If it weren't for the different clothes and face, and just looking at the back, I would have almost thought that Yin Shen Palace himself had gone out again."This kid... is interesting." Yin Shen Palace suddenly raised some expectations and looked at it with burning eyes.Fang Che stood still, raised his sword in his hand, and with a flash of cold light, his feet suddenly changed from a forward step to a forward step.The heel is slightly raised, the arch of the foot is in the air, and the toes are touching the ground. It can be seen from the curvature of the front of the shoe that only the big toe and the second toe are touching the ground, and the toes are in a semi-rotation shape.The left hand sword technique is pinched, as if it has pinched the weak point of the enemy in front. A stream of spiritual energy rises from the Dantian and rushes into the right arm, which is the starting line of the first form of the Blood Spirit Seven Swords.There was a flash of cold light and the sword thrust out.The curvature of the body leaning forward slightly is exactly the same as that of Yin Shen Palace just now.Even that kind of calm charm has a bit of it.Slowly chanting in his mouth: "The Blood Spirit Sword Technique is based on the mind and guided by the will of the spirit. Before the sword comes out, the spirit has arrived. The sword technique has been pinched to draw out the flaw, and the sword technique has been tightened to draw out the sword. The god has moved everywhere on the sword tip. When the enemy's blood is splashed, I have returned. There is no chance of backlash..." He actually recited everything that the Yin Shen Palace read just now, word for word.The body method is exactly the same.The footwork is exactly the same.The sword tactics are exactly the same.The formula is word for word.The first move was changed, and then the second move, the third move, the fourth move... Beside him, Yin Shen Palace's eyes widened.On one side, Mu Linyuan, Hou Fang, Qian Sanjiang and others were all stunned, with their three mouths open so wide they could swallow a goose egg raw.Sun Yuan was not much better.The whole face was dull.Only then did he realize that when he was teaching, this kid didn't even study hard at all.If you can read the Seven Swords of the Blood Spirit once, then what do you teach me?Does it still take an hour?Yin Shen Palace was so shocked that he couldn't even think.With his eyesight, he could tell at a glance that Fang Che had never been exposed to the Seven Swords of the Blood Spirit and had never learned it.Because the jerkiness in each move is very obvious, which is the inevitable jerkiness for beginners.It only has form, but no charm, and it doesn't even have the power to kill.Just follow the same pattern.So the doubt that 'this kid has learned it before' disappeared in just a flash.Unique in the world, unless you teach him and then forget.However, this is too fast!Just once!Remember it all?At this moment, the leader of the Yixin Sect could even hear his own heartbeat speeding up.What a genius!Until the seventh move, which is the last sword of the Seven Blood Spirit Swords, the speed finally slowed down, and several movements were not standard.However, I finally remembered it successfully.After the sword move was executed, there was silence.Fang Che put away his sword and stood still, thinking about his mistakes this time.Then he said softly: "When it came to the fifth sword, when I turned around and drew the sword, my footwork was wrong, my posture was a little off, and the sword technique was half a beat slow... By the seventh sword, it was basically a complete mess, there were... six... eight or nine..., yes, nine mistakes. Moreover, there was a sentence in the formula, 'The sword stirs the enemy's blood, and turns into the ethereal soul to kill'. I'm not sure whether it's right or wrong. Is it to kill? Or to kill? From the artistic conception, it should be the evil of evil spirit, right? Is that the cultivation of momentum?"
